note: Structure of the future OOS decision contract, defined BEFORE any OOS outcome is inspected. OOS access_count remains 0 at the time this contract is written -- this file defines the rule, it does not apply it.

relative_criterion.rule: OOS expectancy_R must be >= DEVELOPMENT-zone frozen-candidate expectancy_R minus a preregistered tolerance band (band value NOT YET SET -- see blocker below)

absolute_floor_criterion.rule: OOS expectancy_R (and/or net_R) must independently clear an absolute economic floor, defined without reference to the DEVELOPMENT-zone baseline or candidate results, so that an OOS result cannot PASS merely for being 'less negative than baseline'
absolute_floor_criterion.value: RESOLVED as of SSC1D-WP1A (2026-09-16): expectancy_R > 0.0 AND profit_factor > 1.0, owner-approved. Full deterministic definitions (formulas, zero-loss PF handling, resolved/unresolved occurrence scope, friction basis) in SSC1D_WP1A_economic_floor_contract.json -- this field is retained here only as a pointer, the authoritative definition lives in that file.

structure.combined_rule: OOS_PASS requires BOTH the relative_criterion AND the absolute_floor_criterion to hold. Either failing alone is sufficient for OOS_FAIL. This prevents the specific failure mode named in the WP1 mission: a candidate whose OOS result is merely less negative than the SSC v1.0.0 baseline (itself already net-negative per HYP_002's evidence, control net_expectancy_R = -0.4075R) passing by relative comparison alone.

blocker.evidence: No universal or SSC-specific absolute economic floor (e.g. a minimum net_expectancy_R, minimum profit_factor, or minimum net_R independent of baseline comparison) exists anywhere in canonical governance. Searched docs/validation/ and config/governance/ for 'economic_floor', 'ECONOMIC_FLOOR', 'absolute threshold' framing -- zero hits. AG_ACCELERATED_VALIDATION_PLAN_V1.md section 9 explicitly forbids inventing universal metrics (PF > 1.4, Sharpe > 1.2, etc.) unless preregistered specifically for the strategy. HYP_001/HYP_002 preregistrations both use baseline-relative decision rules only (e.g. HYP_002: delta_net_expectancy_R > 0 AND TREATMENT_net_expectancy_R > 0 -- note HYP_002's own rule DOES include an absolute component, TREATMENT itself must be net-positive, which is the closest existing precedent for an absolute floor, but it was fixed per-hypothesis, not as a standing canonical constant reusable here without owner re-confirmation).
blocker.recommendation: Following the HYP_002 precedent (absolute component: treatment must independently be net-positive, not merely relatively improved) is the most defensible reuse of existing canonical practice, but this pilot does not have authority to adopt it unilaterally as this pilot's own floor without owner sign-off, since HYP_002's rule was fixed for that specific hypothesis, not declared a standing SSC-wide constant.

mission_directive_compliance.instruction: If no defensible absolute economic floor currently exists in canonical governance, report OOS_ABSOLUTE_ECONOMIC_FLOOR = OWNER_DEFINITION_REQUIRED and STOP before optimization. Do not choose an absolute threshold from observed future candidate results.
mission_directive_compliance.compliance_wp1: COMPLIED at WP1 -- no threshold was chosen by this pilot; OWNER_DEFINITION_REQUIRED was reported and optimization did not proceed.
mission_directive_compliance.compliance_wp1a: SSC1D-WP1A (2026-09-16) recorded the owner-approved floor (expectancy_R > 0.0 AND profit_factor > 1.0) AS SUPPLIED BY THE OWNER, without inspecting any OOS or candidate result first. This resolves the economic-floor blocker; the separate OOS M1 data-authority blocker remains open (see SSC1D_WP0_dataset_role_manifest.json finding_wp1.m1_gap and SSC1D_WP1A_m1_resolution_report.json).
